steps.name: Accept fixture data notice
steps.goal: Tap Agree and continue on the Your data and AI providers screen for this isolated demo fixture. Wait for Home. Do not tap the root element named omg.

steps.name: Open a session in a linked project
steps.goal: On Home, tap the api-gateway folder chip in the project rail. Then open the conversation titled Refactor the rate limiter to a sliding window. Do not type a message.
steps.done: The conversation screen is open: its title is in the top bar and Home's folder list is gone.
expect: Refactor the rate limiter to a sliding window

steps.name: The linked app leads the session menu
steps.goal: Tap Session actions at the top right. Do not select any row.
steps.done: The session menu is open and its first row names the linked app.

steps.name: App actions
steps.goal: Tap the API Gateway row once to open its submenu. Do not tap any action inside it.
steps.done: The app submenu shows its actions.
